simple.meaning: עָרֵב (ʻârêb) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to be agreeable.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 7 times across Psalms, Proverbs, Jeremiah, Ezekiel, Malachi, beginning at Psalms 104:34. Its contexts include offering, sacrifice.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָרֵב (H6149).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: עָרֵב (ʻârêb) / H6149 is traced through Psalms 104:34, Proverbs 3:24, Proverbs 13:19, Jeremiah 6:20 as a generated source-based concept entry.

timeline.evidenceText: Let my meditation be sweet to him.
When you lie down, you will not be afraid.
Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul,
To what purpose does frankincense from Sheba come to me, and the sweet cane from a far country? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices are not pleasing to me.”
On this I awakened, and saw; and my sleep was sweet to me.

therefore see, I will gather all your lovers, with whom you have taken pleasure, and all those who you have loved, with all those who you have hated. I will even gather them against you on every side, and will uncover your nakedness to them, that they may see all your nakedness.
Then the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasant to Yahweh, as in the days of old, and as in ancient years.

definitions.usage: be pleasant(-ing), take pleasure in, be sweet.
definitions.full: H6149. arab III. [ עָרַב ] verb be sweet, pleasing (Late Hebrew id. (rare); Hiph`il Imperfect יעריבו Ecclus 40:21; עָרִיב ᵑ7 adjective pleasant, sweet ); — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular עָֽרְבָה Jer 31:26 my sleep was sweet to me ( לִי ), ׳וְע שְׁנָתֶ֑ךָ consecutive Prov 3:24 ; of offering ע ׳לֹא ׳לי Mal 3:4 ; 2 feminine singular עָרַבְתְּ Ezek 16:37 with עַל person, to whom thou wast pleasing ; 3 plural לִי עָֽרְבוּ לֹא Jer 6:20 (of sacrifice); Imperfect 3masculine singular שִׂיחִי עָלָיו יֶעֱרַב Psa 104:34 let my meditation be pleasing unto him! 3feminine singular לְ תֶּעֱרַב Prov 13:19 (of realized wish); 3 masculine plural לוֺ יֶעֶרְבוּ לֹא Hosea 9:4 (of sacrifice; but Kue Che We GASm Now read יַעַרְכוּ ).
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root (rather identical with 6148 through the idea of close association);
